name: com.zetph.zetsfancyshader
description: PC-only AudioLink-reactive toon + PBR shader for VRChat avatars, with emission FX, geometry break, glitch, interior mapping, subsurface scattering, and a companion eye shader. Optional LTCGI and VRC Light Volumes support activates automatically when those packages are present. Ships its own material inspector, locking, debug views and map packer - no ThryEditor required.
